title: Soledades. Edición digital (Luis de Góngora, 1613) — ed. Antonio Rojas Castro
institution: Antonio Rojas Castro (ed.); Cologne Center for eHumanities (CCeH), Universität zu Köln
notes: TEI encodings and datasets supporting the digital edition of Góngora's Soledades (1613) in the arojascastro/soledades GitHub repository: an annotated edition (soledades_anotada.xml), a critical edition (soledades_critica.xml) and simple transcriptions. The Renascor Corpus harvest labelled this set 'GitHubTEI'. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
